profiles.originalityMeaning: Product-specific decisions without generic software tropes. Conventional fonts are valid when they serve the product.

eligibility: brand expression named in the outcome
profiles.originalityMeaning: A brief-supported point of view that remains usable and coherent.

typography.letterSpacing: Use the product type scale or the font default. Report custom tracking for review and reject decorative tracking without a named role.
typography.lineHeight: Use conventional readable ratios from the product type scale. Report extreme ratios for review and reject arbitrary values without a named role.

iconography.textSymbols: Use a real icon when the control has an icon equivalent. Keep a readable label or accessible name.

status.iconRequirement: Add an icon when it materially improves scanning or comprehension. Do not require one beside every status label.
status.colorRole: Color may reinforce status but cannot be the only signal.

rules.measurement: For every visible element with any corner radius, compare computed width, style, and color on all four border edges. Report exactly one active edge.
allowed: single-edge divider on an element with zero corner radius

rules.measurement: For rounded elements, report inset or zero-blur shadows that create one horizontal or vertical edge.
allowed: soft elevation shadows with visible blur

rules.measurement: Inspect rendered text-transform and source styling.
Review visible authored strings for all-caps words and sentences.
allowed: literal external identifiers or regulated codes that would become inaccurate if changed

rules.measurement: Inspect rendered interface copy for the em dash character.
allowed: verbatim external data when changing it would be inaccurate

rules.measurement: Record custom letter spacing and extreme computed line-height ratios with the owning element and text sample.
Report interactive controls whose visible content is only punctuation or a symbol and which contain no icon asset.
allowed: domain notation with no conventional icon

rules.measurement: Report small circular filled elements with no readable text when they appear beside status language.
Confirm every status remains understandable when color is removed.
allowed: readable text label plus a coherent icon

rules.measurement: Report visible interface text containing a colon after excluding literal times, links, code, protocols, and verbatim data.
Record the number and locations of visible one-edge dividers. Independent review decides whether whitespace and grouping would be clearer.
